mechanism_narrative: A rising housing starts index (HOUST) indicates improving consumer confidence and residential investment, which typically precedes stronger corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST increases by at least 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy stance that typically leads to reduced corporate borrowing and lower equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates a strong labor market, which typically boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of UNRATE falling and PAYEMS rising fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases (i.e., Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows).

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO < 110), the economy is in a supply contraction phase, which typically leads to higher inflation and reduced equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 110.

mechanism_narrative: A rising consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) indicates persistent inflation, which typically leads to higher real interest rates and reduced equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL increases by at least 0.2% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: When residential investment (RSAFS) exceeds $380 billion, it signals robust housing market activity and strong consumer spending, which typically precedes positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS > 380000.

mechanism_narrative: In a regime of low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%), the labor market is tight, which typically leads to wage pressures and inflation, causing the central bank to tighten policy and resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE < 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and a rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a weakening economy, which typically leads to reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of INDPRO falling and UNRATE rising fails to produce negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases (i.e., Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows).
